title: Payment Terms for Device Charges, Student Technology Device Program
content:
Charges on a Student Technology Device Program loan are paid on the Business Office terms below, which are the same for every loan type.

## Terms

| Loan type | Payment methods accepted | Smallest charge total on a loan for which monthly payments are offered (USD) | Number of monthly payments in a payment plan | Credit balance refunded within, after the loan closes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability) | Online card; ACH bank draft; personal check; money order | 100.00 | 3 | 30 calendar days |
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Online card; ACH bank draft; personal check; money order | 100.00 | 3 | 30 calendar days |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Online card; ACH bank draft; personal check; money order | 100.00 | 3 | 30 calendar days |
| Windows Laptop Loan (Standard Liability) | Online card; ACH bank draft; personal check; money order | 100.00 | 3 | 30 calendar days |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Online card; ACH bank draft; personal check; money order | 100.00 | 3 | 30 calendar days |
| Mobile Hotspot Loan | Online card; ACH bank draft; personal check; money order | 100.00 | 3 | 30 calendar days |

## The terms restated

- Four payment methods are accepted, and only these: online card, ACH bank draft, personal check and money order.
- Monthly payments are offered when the charges on a loan total at least 100.00. A loan whose charges total exactly 100.00 is at the threshold and is offered them; one whose charges total 99.99 is not.
- A payment plan runs over 3 monthly payments.
- A credit balance is refunded within 30 calendar days after the loan closes.
